verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: Vengeance will be taken for the children of Israel from those Midianites after they are gathered together with your people.
verses.3: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Men have been chosen from among you to lead the people. They will stand on the hilltops and bring vengeance upon Midian at the hands of Jehovah.”
verses.4: One thousand lamathes, one thousand lamathes for all the tribes of Israel. They shall be sent to the sanctuary.
verses.5: And from all of Israel, eight thousand men were sent to the wilderness. Among them were also twenty-eight thousand soldiers.
verses.6: And Moses sent them to the tabernacle, along with Eleazar, the priest, and all the sacred objects and utensils of the sanctuary.
verses.7: And they stood on Mount Sinai, as Jehovah commanded Moses. They killed every living creature there.
verses.8: And they killed the kings of Midian on their own soil. They killed Oï and Rekem, and Zor, and Chur. They also killed the five kings of Midian. And Balak, son of Boor, was killed in battle.
verses.9: And the children of Israel took captive the women of Midian, along with their children, all their animals, and all their possessions.
verses.10: And all their cities were destroyed, and all their palaces were burned down by fire.
verses.11: And they took away all the livestock, as well as all the goods that belonged to humans and animals.
verses.12: And they brought the captives, along with the priest Eleazar and the elders of the Israelites, to the camp at Mahanaim. It was during the night, when the moon was shining brightly on the slopes of Mount Zion.
verses.13: Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the council went out to call those who were outside the camp.
verses.14: Moses was angry at the orders given by the leaders of the tribes and the leaders of the thousands who came from the army.
verses.15: And Moses said to them, “May every bird fly away from here.”
verses.16: And they became the children of Israel, through the words of God, in order to carry out His commands. The plague came upon them because of Jehovah’s decree.
verses.17: And now, every male was killed in the field. And every female knew that her male partner had been killed.
verses.18: And all those women who did not know how to give birth to a male child.
verses.19: And you shall stay outside the camp for seven days. All those who kill people and all those who commit sins will be punished on the third and seventh day. You and your families will also be punished.
verses.20: And all kinds of garments, and all kinds of utensils, and all kinds of destructive actions, and all kinds of trees will be destroyed.
verses.21: And Elazar, the priest, said to the people who were going into battle: “This is the law of the Torah that Jehovah commanded Moses.”
verses.22: But gold, silver, copper, brass, and iron…
verses.23: Everything that comes into contact with fire will be destroyed by it. But anything that doesn’t come into contact with fire will be preserved in the water.
verses.24: And on the seventh day, you shall wash yourselves with water. After that, you shall enter the camp.
verses.25: And the LORD said to Moses, “…”
verses.26: You shall be the leader of those who are taken captive, both in men and animals. You and Elazar, the priest, along with the leaders of the elders, shall be their leaders.
verses.27: And you divided the captives between those who were wounded in battle and all the others.
verses.28: And they shall be removed from the throne of God, from among those soldiers who go out to battle. One soul will be taken from each of the five classes of people: from men, from women, from children, and from animals.
verses.29: From half of it, you shall take some and give it to Elazar the priest as a offering to Jehovah.
verses.30: And from half the children of Israel, take one man from among the fifty men—from the males of the morning, from among the warriors and the sheepherders—from all the animals. Then you shall give them to the Levites, who will be responsible for keeping the Temple of Jehovah.
verses.31: And Moses and Aaron, the priests, did as Jehovah commanded them.
verses.32: And the plunder was extremely large. The people of the tribe of Zebulun captured six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep.
verses.33: And on the third day, seventy thousand.
verses.34: And one hundred and sixty thousand men.
verses.35: And the soul of a man is different from the souls of women. They do not know what it means to have a male or female soul. Two thousand and three hundred souls are like that.
verses.36: And the half was a portion of those who were born from the herd. The number of them was three hundred thousand, three hundred and seventy-five thousand.
verses.37: And the throne of Jehovah was made from six cubits long, five cubits wide, and seventy cubits high.
verses.38: And in the morning, it was six hundred and thirty thousand. And from those, two hundred and seventy were given to Jehovah.
verses.39: And there were thirty thousand chariots, and five thousand horses. And from them, one chariot was dedicated to Jehovah. And there were also sixty chariots in total.
verses.40: And the souls of man are six hundred and ten thousand. From these, two hundred and thirty souls belong to Jehovah.
verses.41: And Moses gave the ark of the covenant of the LORD to Eleazar, the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.42: And half of the children of Israel were those who were separated from the people who lived in the land.
verses.43: And half of the herd consisted of three hundred and thirty thousand sheep.
verses.44: And in the morning, six thousand and thirty thousand.
verses.45: And there were thirty thousand chariots, and five thousand horses.
verses.46: And the soul of a man is sixteen thousand.
verses.47: And Moses took one out of every fifty men and women from the people of Israel. He gave them to the Levites, who were responsible for guarding the tabernacle of God, as God commanded Moses.
verses.48: And they came forward to Moses, those who were among the leaders of the thousands. They were the leaders of the tribes and the rulers of the nations.
verses.49: And they said to Moses, “Your servants will take the heads of those soldiers who are in our hands. No one will be punished for this.”
verses.50: And let there be a man who approaches before Jehovah’s altar. He must bring along all kinds of gold jewelry, and he must also wear a crown of gold on his head. This will be done before Jehovah.
verses.51: And Moses and Aaron, the priests, took away all the gold from them, along with everything else that was made of gold.
verses.52: And all the gold that was taken as a tribute to Yahweh amounted to six thousand seven hundred and fifty tons. This gold came from the treasures of the thousands, and from the treasures of the tons.
verses.53: The people of the congregation scattered apart one by one.
verses.54: And Moses and Aaron, the priests, took the gold from the treasuries of the people. They brought it to the tabernacle of the Lord, in memory of the children of Israel before Jehovah.
